faqs.a:
The following words, terms, and phrases, when used in this division, shall have the
               following meanings:
Loading and/or unloading
means the continuous and uninterrupted activity of placing property into or removing
               property from a vehicle, or the receiving or discharging of passengers from a vehicle.
Time,
in the context of hours set forth on any traffic control sign, means mountain standard
               time, or mountain daylight time, depending on the date as prescribed by state law.
Traffic control sign
means a temporary or permanent sign or structure on, above, or adjacent to a street
               or in a parking structure or lot placed by authority of a city official having jurisdiction
               for the purpose of regulating, warning, or guiding traffic, or limiting, regulating,
               restricting, or prohibiting the parking, standing, or stopping of vehicles.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
